hero.identity: Web applications, map solutions and automation
hero.headline: What is complicated today can become digitally simpler.
hero.subheadline: I develop custom web applications, map solutions, and automations for workflows that take too much time, feel chaotic, or cannot be properly mapped with existing software.
hero.intro: You explain the challenge. I develop a fitting digital solution from it.
hero.techLine: Web development · GIS & mapping · Automation · AI integration

problems.headline: Does one of these situations sound familiar?
problems.text: A digital project often does not start with a finished idea, but with a workflow that takes too much time, an application that no longer fits, or information that is hard to use.
problems.ideaNote: Already have a concrete idea? Together we turn it into a realistic concept and a working first version.

scattered-data.title: Important information is spread across multiple places
scattered-data.description: Data sits in spreadsheets, emails, folders, or different tools – making it hard to get an overview and make quick decisions.

manual-work.title: Manual tasks take too much time
manual-work.description: Information is transferred multiple times, documents are processed manually, or recurring tasks are done by hand again and again.

legacy-software.title: The existing application is hard to extend
legacy-software.description: New features require more and more effort, and even small changes can put existing areas at risk.

geo-data.title: Locations, areas, or routes are hard to overview
geo-data.description: Geographic information exists but cannot be easily displayed, edited, or used meaningfully in everyday work.

ai-trend.title: AI should help – but only with a meaningful use case
ai-trend.description: You are looking for a concrete point in the workflow where artificial intelligence actually saves time or makes work more reliable.

standard-software.title: Standard software does not match the actual workflow
standard-software.description: Existing solutions are too complicated, too inflexible, or only partially cover the actual work process.

process.headline: From challenge to a working solution
process.text: You do not need a finished concept or technical specification. First we clarify what is difficult today and what should work better in the future.

understand.title: Understand the starting situation
understand.description: We clarify what the current workflow looks like, where difficulties arise, and what improvement you want.

plan.title: Define the goal and a sensible solution
plan.description: I translate the requirements into understandable features and propose a realistic technical path.

build.title: Develop a first usable version
build.description: Instead of developing in isolation for a long time, a version is created as early as possible that can be reviewed and tested.

improve.title: Review and improve in real use
improve.description: The solution is checked based on real use, adjusted, and extended with additional features if needed.

whyWork.headline: Technology implemented clearly and with a focus on solutions

problem-first.title: You do not have to choose the technology first
problem-first.description: First we clarify what should run better in everyday work. The right technology follows from that – not the other way around.

communication.title: You do not have to translate technical decisions yourself
communication.description: I explain options, limits, and decisions so you can follow what is being built and why – even without deep developer knowledge.

incremental.title: You get something usable early instead of months of planning
incremental.description: A first version to try out is often more valuable than an oversized concept that is not used for a long time.

existing-systems.title: Working parts stay in place
existing-systems.description: Not everything has to be rebuilt. Often a targeted modernisation is enough to make things extensible and maintainable again.

breadth.title: Different building blocks from one source
breadth.description: Web interfaces, maps, data, and automation can be brought together in one coherent solution – without media breaks.

practical.title: The solution has to work in everyday use
practical.description: Clean code matters – but what counts is that users understand the solution and actually use it in their daily work.

services.headline: Digital solutions tailored to your task
services.text: The technology follows the task – not the other way around. Together we first clarify what improvement you want. Then a solution emerges that fits your workflows.

webapps.title: Bring workflows together in a fitting application
webapps.description: I develop applications that fit your workflow exactly. From a first usable version to step-by-step extension, a solution emerges that is easy to use and maintainable in the long term.
webapps.techHint: Possible technologies: Angular, TypeScript, .NET and PostgreSQL

automation.title: Automate recurring tasks sensibly
automation.description: I analyse existing workflows and develop solutions that reduce unnecessary work steps. Data can be processed automatically, information merged, and recurring tasks executed reliably.

gis.title: Present locations and geographic data clearly
gis.description: I develop interactive map solutions with which locations, routes, areas, and other spatial information can be easily displayed, edited, and analysed.
gis.techHint: Possible technologies: OpenLayers, Leaflet, GeoServer, GeoJSON and SLD

modernization.title: Modernise existing software step by step
modernization.description: Not every application has to be rebuilt from scratch. I modernise existing solutions step by step, replace problematic areas, and ensure that important functions remain available during the transition.

ki.title: Use AI for a specific workflow
ki.description: I support the selection and implementation of meaningful AI applications. The focus is not on the term artificial intelligence, but on whether a task can be done faster, more easily, or more reliably as a result.
outcomes: connecting language models to existing processes

consulting.title: Turn a challenge into an actionable plan
consulting.description: You do not need a finished specification yet. Together we translate your starting situation into concrete features, sensible steps, and a realistic technical solution.

projects.headline: Selected projects and solutions
projects.text: My projects show mainly which challenge was solved and what result was achieved – not just which technologies were used.
projects.confidentialityNotice: Note: Professional projects and personal work are not available on GitHub or to third parties due to confidentiality and data protection. I am happy to provide details on personal request if someone would like to verify.

openlayers-kartenmodul.title: Modern map application for complex domain data
openlayers-kartenmodul.shortDescription: A grown map application modernised step by step – with clearer tools for displaying, selecting, and editing geographic data.
openlayers-kartenmodul.problem: The existing map solution had grown technically complex and could only be extended with high effort. New map tools and modern interaction concepts had to be integrated without interrupting existing business processes.
openlayers-kartenmodul.solution: I migrated core functions step by step to a modern, modular map architecture. Tools were created for drawing, measuring, selecting, editing, and visualising complex geographic information.
openlayers-kartenmodul.benefit: The application can be extended and maintained more easily. Users receive clearer tools while existing processes continue to work.
openlayers-kartenmodul.contribution: Concept and implementation of map tools, processing of GeoJSON data, implementation of complex display rules, and integration into an existing .NET application.

mapfish-templates.title: Automated map output for reports
mapfish-templates.shortDescription: Clean and standardised transfer of map displays into reports and print documents without manual post-processing.
mapfish-templates.problem: Map content previously had to be transferred and formatted manually into reports, which was time-consuming and error-prone. Print quality was inconsistent.
mapfish-templates.solution: Templates and processes were developed that automatically convert map content into print-ready formats. The design is adapted to the respective report standards.
mapfish-templates.benefit: Time savings when creating reports, consistent and professional presentation of maps in documents.
mapfish-templates.contribution: Development and customisation of Mapfish Print templates, definition of print layouts, and integration into the existing workflow.

kendo-ui.title: Clear user interfaces for domain applications
kendo-ui.shortDescription: Improvement of existing web interfaces to display and edit complex data more easily, with direct linking to map views.
kendo-ui.problem: The existing internal applications were hard to use and offered little overview of complex data volumes. Linking lists with map views was cumbersome.
kendo-ui.solution: I implemented modern UI components for a clear presentation of data in tables with filter and sort functions. Dialog windows simplify editing, and a direct link to the map enables quick navigation.
kendo-ui.benefit: Users find required information faster, data editing becomes more intuitive, and map integration makes work more efficient.
kendo-ui.contribution: Implementation of Kendo UI components, design of interactive tables and dialogs, and coupling of data lists with OpenLayers map components.

3d-scan.title: Guided image capture for complete 3D scans
3d-scan.shortDescription: An application that guides users step by step through capturing an object and shows which perspectives are still missing.
3d-scan.problem: When photographing objects for 3D scans, important perspectives were often forgotten, leading to incomplete models. This required repeated captures and increased time spent.
3d-scan.solution: I developed an application with guided camera movement. It shows the user in real time which areas of the object have already been captured and which perspectives are still missing.
3d-scan.benefit: Visual guidance reduces incomplete captures and improves the foundation for later 3D reconstruction.
3d-scan.contribution: Development of the user interface and camera integration logic, real-time visualisation of capture progress, and implementation of the 3D model preview.

route-navi.title: Clear route planning for many destinations
route-navi.shortDescription: A clear application that displays many destinations in a structured way and simplifies daily route planning.
route-navi.problem: With many stops, normal navigation apps quickly become unclear or require paid subscriptions. Addresses from existing lists also had to be prepared manually first.
route-navi.solution: I developed an application where addresses can be imported, checked, displayed on a map, and arranged in a sensible order.
route-navi.benefit: The user gets a clear map view, a sorted stop list, and a better foundation for daily tour planning.
route-navi.contribution: Concept of the user interface for import and route planning, implementation of map integration with OpenLayers, logic for route optimisation and data management.

dabubble.title: Custom communication platform for teams
dabubble.shortDescription: A custom chat application for team communication with channels, direct messages, and central user management.
dabubble.problem: Teams needed a flexible communication solution that can be adapted to specific needs and offers full control over data and features without relying on external services.
dabubble.solution: I developed a complete chat application with features such as registration, login, private and public channels, direct messages, and avatar management.
dabubble.benefit: Teams can communicate in a customisable environment, productivity increases through targeted information flows, and dependence on standard solutions is reduced.
dabubble.contribution: Development of the entire frontend with Angular and TypeScript, implementation of real-time communication with Firebase, and integration of authentication and user profiles.

join.title: Intuitive task manager with Kanban board
join.shortDescription: Visual Kanban board for tasks – with clear assignment, status, and responsibilities in the team.
join.problem: Task management in teams was unclear. Tasks were often forgotten, priorities were vague, and assignment to team members was not transparent.
join.solution: I developed a task manager that displays tasks in a visual Kanban board. Features such as drag-and-drop for status changes, assignment to people, and categorisation make planning intuitive and transparent.
join.benefit: Improved overview of project progress, clear responsibilities, and more efficient coordination of tasks.
join.contribution: Concept and implementation of the entire application, development of the drag-and-drop Kanban board with JavaScript, and connection to Firebase for data persistence and user management.

sharkie.title: Interactive jump-and-run learning game
sharkie.shortDescription: A simple 2D jump-and-run game that playfully teaches basic concepts of object-oriented programming.
sharkie.problem: Beginners in programming often need interactive examples to understand abstract concepts such as object orientation. Classic tutorials are often dry and not very motivating.
sharkie.solution: I developed a jump-and-run game where game elements are modelled as objects and interact. The code is modular and easy to follow.
sharkie.benefit: Playful access to programming concepts, better understanding through direct interaction, and a motivating learning environment.
sharkie.contribution: Concept and development of game mechanics, implementation of the object-oriented structure with JavaScript, and graphical implementation of game elements.

roblox.title: Roblox game logic for player retention
roblox.shortDescription: Development of game mechanics and systems in Roblox that promote player retention and automate recurring tasks.
roblox.problem: When creating games in Roblox, it is a challenge to motivate players long term and implement efficient systems for in-game economies or progress.
roblox.solution: I developed modular systems for coin collection, levelling up, shops, and upgrades within Roblox. These are based on Lua scripts and designed to be easily extended.
roblox.benefit: Increased motivation through clear progress indicators and reward systems. Simplified management of game content and faster iterations during development.
roblox.contribution: Concept and implementation of in-game systems with Lua in Roblox Studio and development of modular scripts.

ki-workflows.title: AI-powered workflows for development and everyday life
ki-workflows.shortDescription: Which AI tools really relieve the load in everyday work and development – tested systematically and assessed honestly.
ki-workflows.problem: The potential of AI tools is large, but it is hard to assess which applications actually add value and how they can be integrated efficiently into existing workflows.
ki-workflows.solution: I test various AI tools – from coding assistants to language models to local LLMs – with the goal of finding concrete use cases that make work easier.
ki-workflows.benefit: Identification of AI solutions that enable real time savings, less manual research, and faster code development with a realistic assessment of possibilities.
ki-workflows.contribution: Systematic testing and integration of AI tools into the development workflow, implementation of interfaces to local LLMs, and development of prompt strategies.

about.headline: I develop solutions at the intersection of software, maps, and automation
about.shortText: You do not have to describe your request in technical terms. Simply tell me what is difficult today and what should work better in the future.
text: I am a software developer with a particular focus on web applications and interactive map solutions. In my professional work I modernise and extend complex applications, develop new map tools, and integrate features into existing systems.
In my own projects as well, I deliver complete digital solutions – from the first concept through user interface and data processing to operating the application.
It is especially important to me not to use technical possibilities just because they are modern. A solution must solve a real problem, remain easy to use, and be sensibly extendable later.
I get up to speed quickly on new topics, but I decide based on what makes sense for the concrete task – not based on trends.
values: Your advantage first – not a tech show
Clear communication – you always know where we stand
Quick first versions to try out
Only tools that serve the result
AI only where it truly lightens your load
expectations: An honest assessment of what your project needs
A first version to test before everything is locked in
